tabs.title: Cedar Observatory visitor guide
tabs.body: Cedar Observatory opens at 7 PM every Friday. Admission costs 12 dollars per adult. Children under twelve enter free with a paying adult. The observatory offers a public telescope viewing session and a short introduction to the constellations. Visitors should bring warm clothing because the telescope platform is outdoors. Tickets are sold at the entrance. The visitor guide contains no information about parking prices or restaurant reservations.
